# Engineering

This plugin groups related workflows under one installation. Open the matching
contract before acting; do not answer from this index alone.

- [Architecture](../../references/modules/architecture.md)
  Choose and review the smallest maintainable runtime, frontend stack, persistence model, and process boundary before implementation. Use for new applications, browser extensions, desktop shells, web apps, migrations, and stack decisions.
- [Az Clean Code](../../references/modules/az-clean-code.md)
  Apply explicit, flat, reusable, data-driven constraints when writing, reviewing, refactoring, or consistently styling application code.
- [Godot 3 Dev](../../references/modules/godot-3-dev.md)
  Write, review, and down-port Godot 3.x (3.6) GDScript and scenes without re-calling engine-dispatched virtuals and without Godot 4.x symbols.

Load only the supporting references the task needs. The plugin is self-contained;
do not look for a shared AzSkills entry or for other plugins in the catalog.
